dialog.body: Good morning, Newport Recreation, this is Beth. Happy day after Christmas. How can I help you?

Oh, hi Beth, good morning! Happy day after Christmas to you too. Um, my name is Diego. I am calling because I want to sign up for some classes, maybe for me and maybe for a friend, and I have some questions first.
Sure thing, Diego, ask away. What kind of classes are you thinking about?

So I saw on the city website, the winter list, there is the, how you say, the open gym basketball and also a pottery thing, and a swim, no way, I don't remember exactly. But first I want to know, is there a scholarship for the class fees? Because I am watching my grocery budget very closely this month, you know, after the holidays everything is so expensive.

Oh, I hear you, it's been that kind of month for a lot of people. Yes, we do have a scholarship program for program fees. You fill out a short application and it's based on need. It's not just for kids either, so ask about it for any class you pick.
No way, for adults too? That is great. Because I thought maybe it was only for the children.
I'd double check on the specific class when you register, but generally the application isn't only for kids. I can mail it or email it to you, or you can pick one up at the office.
Okay, okay. Can you send by email? Or, wait, is it easier if I just come pick up? I am not far, I can walk.
Either works. If you come in, we're open today until the afternoon, and you can fill it out right here and ask me questions while you do it.
Perfect, I will come by today then. Now the other question, about age limits. The pottery, is it for all ages or you need to be, like, eighteen? And the basketball also.

It depends on the class. Some of the pottery sessions are for adults only and some are family or youth sessions. The open gym usually has an age split too, so there's a younger time and an adult time. The class listing should show an age range under each one.
Yes, yes, I see now, I think it says sixteen and up for one of them. But I am not sure if that is the pottery or the, the other one, the swim.
Tell you what, tell me which one you're most interested in and I'll pull it up while we're talking.
The pottery, I think. On Tuesday nights, I believe.
[pause] Okay, let me look. Yep, I see the Tuesday evening one. That's listed as an adult session, so you'd be fine. If your friend is an adult too, same thing.
Oh, wonderful. My friend is thirty-five, so no problem. No way, this is easier than I thought.
Glad to hear it! Do you want me to put your name down so we have it started, and then you can bring the scholarship form when you come in?
Yes please. It is Diego Figueroa, F-I-G-U-E-R-O-A. And my phone, if you need, is 401-555-0166.
Got it, Diego Figueroa, and I have that number. I'll note that you're coming in today about the scholarship application and the Tuesday pottery class.
Great, thank you so much, Beth. You are very kind. I will see you this afternoon, or, well, before lunch, maybe.
Sounds good. See you soon, and enjoy the rest of your holiday week!
You too, bye bye!
